title: Heavy touch, go in
text: They're coming at you. What do you do?
tip: Watch the ball, not their feet. A big touch is your moment, if a mate is there to help.

options.why: Backing off lets them collect it and run at you again.

options.text: Stay on your feet and wait
options.why: Safe, but you give them time to get the ball back under control.

options.text: Go in for the tackle now
options.why: The look showed a heavy touch and cover close by. Go in now while the ball is loose.

scan.prompt: Their attacker is running at you with the ball. Look before you decide.
